```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

# Set your root directory
root_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blups_ddm1_individual_tes/log2/with_K"  # change if needed

# Find all *.assoc.txt files recursively
assoc_files <- list.files(
  path = root_dir,
  pattern = "\\.assoc\\.txt$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Function to extract a readable name from the file path
get_name <- function(filepath) {
  # Extract meaningful parts: blups_* / (cluster*) / log2|zscale / with_K
  parts <- strsplit(filepath, "/")[[1]]
  # Keep parts starting from blups_* folder
  blups_idx <- grep("^blups_", parts)
  if (length(blups_idx) > 0) {
    paste(parts[blups_idx:length(parts)], collapse = " / ")
  } else {
    basename(filepath)
  }
}

# Read each file, get top 20 SNPs by p-value
results <- map_dfr(assoc_files, function(f) {
  message(sprintf("Processing %d/%d: %s", which(assoc_files == f), length(assoc_files), basename(f)))
  df <- read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df %>%
    arrange(p_wald) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20) %>%
    mutate(source_file = get_name(f))
})

# Save to CSV
write_csv(results, "top20_gwas_snps.csv")
cat("Done! Results saved to top20_gwas_snps_individual_tes.csv\n")
cat("Total rows:", nrow(results), "\n")
```


# Read GWAS
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
peaks <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/peaks_analysis/top20_gwas_snps.csv", sep=",", header=T)
# Remove individual genes and TEs
peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes <- peaks[
  !grepl("individual_genes|womaf|no_K|zscale", peaks$source_file),
]
# Filter on pwald
#peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes<-peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes[-log10(peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes$p_wald)>6,]
# Select only zscaled
peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf <- peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes[
  grepl("average_ddm1_log2_maf005", peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes$source_file), ] 
## DBP analysis
#peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf <- peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf %>%
#  filter(chr == 5, ps >= 842289, ps <= 845454)

## Cluster peaks in proximity
peaks_sorted <- peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf %>%
  arrange(chr, ps) %>%
  group_by(chr) %>%
  mutate(
    locus_id = cumsum(c(1, diff(ps) > 100000))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(locus_label = paste0("chr", chr, "_locus", locus_id))


# Count how often peaks appear 
locus_counts <- peaks_sorted %>%
  group_by(locus_label, chr) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_gwas = n_distinct(source_file),   # how many GWAS share this locus
    n_peaks = n(),
    mean_ps = mean(ps),
    min_p = min(p_wald),
    source_files = paste(unique(source_file), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_gwas), min_p)

# Bubble plot: chromosome vs position, size = n_gwas
ggplot(locus_counts, aes(x = mean_ps / 1e6, y = factor(chr), size = n_gwas, color = n_gwas)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = "Chromosome", size = "# GWAS", color = "# GWAS",
       title = "Shared GWAS peaks across studies") +
  theme_bw()
```
## In which phenotypes peak appears the most
```{r}
# Split source_files string and count per phenotype
phenotype_counts <- locus_counts %>%
  separate_rows(source_files, sep = "; ") %>%
  mutate(
    phenotype = source_files %>%
      gsub(".*/", "", .) %>%
      gsub("\\.average_ddm1_log2_maf005\\.assoc\\.txt", "", .)
  ) %>%
  count(phenotype, sort = TRUE)

locus_counts %>%
  filter(n_gwas >= 20) %>%
  mutate(locus_label = reorder(locus_label, n_gwas)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = locus_label, y = n_gwas, fill = -log10(min_p))) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#90CAF9", "#1565C0", "#B71C1C"),
                       name = "-log10(p)") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Locus", y = "# phenotypes with signal",
       title = "Loci recurring across phenotypes") +
  theme_bw()

## DBP contribution 
locus_counts_dbp <-locus_counts[locus_counts$locus_label=="chr5_locus3",]
## Calculate contribution of DBP
```
## Phenotypes contribution
```{r}
locus_counts_dbp %>%
  separate_rows(source_files, sep = "; ") %>%
  mutate(
    phenotype = source_files %>%
      gsub(".*/", "", .) %>%
      gsub("\\.average_ddm1_log2_maf005\\.assoc\\.txt", "", .)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    peaks_sorted %>%
      mutate(phenotype = source_file %>%
               gsub(".*/", "", .) %>%
               gsub("\\.average_ddm1_log2_maf005\\.assoc\\.txt", "", .)) %>%
      group_by(locus_label, phenotype) %>%
      slice_min(p_wald, n = 1) %>%          # best SNP per phenotype per locus
      select(locus_label, phenotype, ps, p_wald),
    by = c("locus_label", "phenotype")
  ) %>%
  select(locus_label, phenotype, ps, p_wald) %>%
  arrange(p_wald) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

locus_counts_dbp %>%

                        name = "-log10(p)") +

library(ggplot2)

## What are the GWAses which share loci?
```{r}
shared_loci <- locus_counts %>%
  filter(n_gwas > 10) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_gwas))

# Which source files are involved?
contributing_phenotypes <- shared_loci %>%
  dplyr::select(locus_label, n_gwas, source_files) %>%
  separate_rows(source_files, sep = "; ") %>%
  dplyr::count(source_files, sort = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(phenotype = source_files, n_loci_contributed = n)

# Plot 
contributing_phenotypes$phenotype <- gsub(".*/", "", contributing_phenotypes$phenotype)
ggplot(contributing_phenotypes, aes(n_loci_contributed, phenotype)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5))+xlab("n of loci with significant SNPs in +/- 100Kb from the SNP")

ggplot(contributing_phenotypes, aes(x = n_loci_contributed, y = reorder(phenotype, n_loci_contributed))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5)) +
  xlab("n of loci with significant SNPs in +/- 100Kb from the SNP") +
  ylab("Phenotype")
```

# Upload TE annotation
```{r}
te_annotation <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_Transposable_Elements.txt", header=T)

# Extract TE name from phenotype (part before the first dot)
contributing_phenotypes <- contributing_phenotypes %>%
  mutate(
    phenotype_clean = trimws(phenotype),
    te_name = sub("\\..*", "", phenotype_clean)  # everything before first dot
  )

# Join with te_annotation
contributing_with_family <- contributing_phenotypes %>%
  left_join(te_annotation, by = c("te_name" = "Transposon_Family"))

# Count by Superfamily
superfamily_counts <- contributing_with_family %>%
  filter(!is.na(Transposon_Super_Family)) %>%
  group_by(Transposon_Super_Family) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n_distinct(phenotype_clean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

# Pie chart
ggplot(superfamily_counts, aes(x = reorder(Transposon_Super_Family, n), y = n, fill = Transposon_Super_Family)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Contributing phenotypes by TE Superfamily",
       x = "Superfamily", y = "Number of phenotypes") +
  expand_limits(y = max(superfamily_counts$n) * 1.1)  # space for labels
```
## Plot significance of the peaks
```{r}
peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf <- peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes[
  grepl("average_ddm1_zscale_maf005", peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes$source_file), ]

peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf$phenotype <- gsub(".*/", "", peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf$source_file)

peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf_filt <- peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf[
  peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf$phenotype %in% contributing_phenotypes$phenotype, ]
# Filter by the position
peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf_filt <- peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf_filt[
  peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf_filt$chr == 1 & 
  peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf_filt$ps > (22408743 - 3000000) & 
  peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf_filt$ps < (22408743 + 3000000), ]

ggplot(peaks_no_ind_genes_no_ind_tes_transf_filt, aes(x = -log10(p_wald))) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "steelblue", color = "white", bins = 30) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "-log10(p_wald)", y = "Count", title = "Distribution of -log10 pwald")
```
